chapter_description.p: The Categorical module provides arrays whose elements belong to a fixed set of text categories.

keyword.name: addcats
keyword.description: Add categories to a categorical array.

keyword.name: categories
keyword.description: List categories of a categorical array.

keyword.name: combinations
keyword.description: Generate all combinations of categorical values.

keyword.name: histcounts
keyword.description: Count categorical values for histogram-style summaries.

keyword.name: iscategorical
keyword.description: Determine whether an array is categorical.

keyword.name: isordinal
keyword.description: Determine whether a categorical array is ordinal.

keyword.name: isprotected
keyword.description: Determine whether a categorical array is protected.

keyword.name: mergecats
keyword.description: Merge categories in a categorical array.

keyword.name: removecats
keyword.description: Remove categories from a categorical array.

keyword.name: renamecats
keyword.description: Rename categories in a categorical array.

keyword.name: reordercats
keyword.description: Reorder categories in a categorical array.

keyword.name: setcats
keyword.description: Set the category list of a categorical array.
